checks.name: Existing/new app settings default to system DNS and expose only safe web preferences
Teacher explicitly selects domestic resolver and saves through actual HeroUI/Hana settings
Natural DeepSeek actually searches, reads MOE body, receives real URL/time and produces a sourced education answer
Actual public explanation/tool/next explanation/final ordering is preserved; composer empty
Independent native web capability is present once; public receipt omits query/body and records returned sources
Actual 1366x768 source/time and resident composer are accessible
Actual 1920x1080 source/time and resident composer are accessible
Explicit source click reaches native opener after recorded-source/DNS validation; forged URL refused
Actual secondary window denied both network-setting and source-open typed endpoints
Stale network preference cannot overwrite teacher selection
Running network task rejects setting mutation; actual stop reaches interrupted terminal
Actual restart preserves source history/preferences/native prefix and does not replay interrupted network task
Actual inaccessible public page produces a failed tool and human error receipt without fake source
Explicit web disable removes future tools while prior native capability/history remain readable
Formal renderer completes all actions without page errors

boundaries: Actual isolated formal Electron/Pi/DeepSeek plus real anonymous AnySearch and MOE HTTP body
AliDNS explicitly chosen in app settings; current system fake DNS failure retained; no OS proxy/DNS/VPN changes or VPN-off claim
OS source launch intercepted after real user click and main source/DNS validation; no user browser modified
